title: 查看 GitLab 合并请求
summary: 按项目内 IID 查看合并请求详情。
description: Use project_repo_id returned by git_repo_list. Only merge requests whose source and target are in this GitLab project are supported. Use the MR iid from gitlab.mr.list or gitlab.mr.create.
result_description: The MR with iid, title, state, draft, source_branch, target_branch, sha, web_url and detailed_merge_status. Includes description and pipeline_status when available.
